title: Grilled Squid Tagine
description: A Moroccan-inspired dish featuring grilled squid, served in a flavorful tagine sauce. Gluten-free and perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: 1. Rinse the squid under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the squid and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
4. Transfer the squid to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
5. Reduce heat to medium and add the tagine to the skillet.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, or until fragrant.
7. Add the lemon juice, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper to the skillet.
8. Stir to combine and cook for an additional minute.
9. To assemble the dish, place the grilled squid on a plate and spoon the tagine sauce over the top.
10. Serve immediately and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
